question_text: For each crowd-mode camera_location on 2025-12-08 (UTC), report the average head_count over the full day.

gold.sql: SELECT camera_location, ROUND(AVG(head_count), 2) AS avg_hc FROM events WHERE event_type='crowd' AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z' GROUP BY camera_location ORDER BY camera_location

metadata.note: GROUP BY camera_location restricted to event_type='crowd'. Returns 5 rows (one per crowd cam).
